about: Overseer's daemon protocol: every method, its class for devices, and its phone status. The gateway's checks (daemon/src/gateway/classes.rs) and the app's types (phone/scripts/gen-protocol.mjs) are both built from this file. A daemon method that is missing here fails the test suite. A method marked planned is not built yet: the daemon refuses it as unknown, and the test suite fails if it is dispatched while still marked planned.

classes.self: The calling device's own session and settings. Every device.
classes.control: Changes something. Full control devices only, with a request id.

shapes: How shapes are written: string, number, boolean, null, json (anything); T? may be null or absent; T[] is a list; record<T> is an object with any keys; 'a'|'b' is one of these texts; a name is a type from `types`; an object lists its fields. A daemon test checks real results and events against these shapes, and the app's types are generated from them.
